signs.text: The assay-scales, under a cloth. Nobody has lifted it in seventy years; the dust on it is even.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 A (the tollhouse)

signs.text: THE TARIFF. Ingots by the stamp, lead by the pig, litharge by the jar. Charcoal, timber, salt, tallow, rope and bone-ash down. The prices are in a coin with a king's face nobody uses now.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 (trade goods: up and down; INFERENCE, PROPOSED)

signs.text: Brick, and a red mark cut across it. The old cut a shaft crew broke into, sixty years ago. The water went bad through here, and then the town burned.
signs.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the Water Burning: an old dwarven cut feeding a cistern); spec §4.3 A

signs.text: The stamp-mill wheel. The ore it broke is long gone; it turns because the covenant says the town's fountains must run, and the wheel is what meters them.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 A (the falls-works)

signs.text: The high seat of the Silversands. Empty. He stands at the door.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the clan hall)

signs.text: The oath-stone of the Silversands. Every one of them put a hand here once. The band of gold is worn bright at hand height.
The hero-wall: the highway's dead, names cut in rows. Where a row stops short, a family stopped.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the hero-wall; a family's row ending is what "wiped out" looks like on stone)

signs.text: The Forge-Father's niche: an anvil, worn to a saddle in the middle.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (the Dwarven Triad: Motsognir, the Forge-Father); spec §4.3 B

signs.text: Rekknar's ledger-stone. Every line on it balances.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (Rekknar the Reckoner); spec §4.3 B

signs.text: A plain cut in the rock with nothing in it. The Dormant's.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (Dvalgarda, the vigil); spec §4.3 B (the sect is never named here)

signs.text: The smokehouse: meat, and nothing else. Food comes down the highway now, not up.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the kitchens; the economy reversed — INFERENCE, PROPOSED); §12 correction (the dream is on vice row)

signs.text: The brewhouse. Dwarves.
Six tiers of bunks up here, and a season's troops fill two of them. Dust on the rest.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the barracks tiers, most of them dark)
